Good local Vietnamese spring roll food
Oct 2019
Just finished our dinner there at Hoàng Ty - Đặc sản Trảng Bàng - Trương Quốc Dung. We ordered the "Combo Nem Nuong Hoang Mao" and " Cá lóc nướng lu cuốn bánh tráng". Our impression is mixed. WhileThe food tastes pretty good (for Vietnamese locals) with ample supply of fresh vegetables; it lacks atmosphere. The restaurant is very noisy with kids running around and server busy cleaning up tables and mop the floor. The room light is too well lit and no background music. Definitely not a good place for a relaxing, romantic dinner. The food looks fresh and clean, and is more suitable for locals, and family type. Just my opinion. See pictures inside
